_comment: Combo numbers. The multiplier multiplies all XP. Proposed numbers; the board judges them in playtests. Multiplier 1.0 means no combo. collision_cut and drain_wait_seconds are decided (Game loop architecture, Decisions).

thread_the_needle._comment: T-272, proposals for the playtest (Level design, Decisions, "Thread the needle"). Worth (trick_add.thread_the_needle): 0.5, as ALT DRIFT! and AIR 360!, twice a FULL 360!, since it needs a line aimed through a gap the board placed. repeat_seconds: the same pair pays again on a later pass in either direction, once this long has gone by since it last paid, so weaving back and forth over the line does not pay every crossing. counts_in_air: a pass in the air (a jump through the gap) counts too; the car can't fly over the obstacles themselves, since a car in the air crashes into them as on the ground. touch_window_seconds and clear_seconds: a touch of either obstacle in the window before the car crosses the line, or until clear_seconds after it, voids the pass (the crash cuts the combo as always); the trick pays clear_seconds after the crossing.

drift_pay._comment: A whole drift pays once, when it ends (Drifting, Decisions, T-246): seconds of drift times per_second, nothing under min_seconds, at most max. Proposals for the playtest.
